Frequented by regulars
Dec 2023 • Family
On one side of the street which borders the coast for kilometers, a succession of hotels, on the other various shops and restaurants specializing in seafood, almost all with touts on the sidewalk. At Bibo there are no touts but the first two floors are crowded. You can choose at the entrance before sitting down which shellfish, crustaceans and fish you wish to taste. The freshness of the products is guaranteed, the fish well prepared.
The only downside is the success of this restaurant and its crowds in poorly soundproofed spaces which resemble a canteen.

Super Fresh Seafood and Honest Pricing
Oct 2019
After encountering thieves and pickpockets at the Red Sand Dunes, we were determined not to get cheated (again). So we visited Bi Bo reading the good reviews. It is a family-run restaurant and there isn't someone at the front hustling you to go in. (Plus point, since it means they aren't that desperate) It was a SUPERB choice. We asked for recommendations on how to cook our seafood - ordered 1kg of tamarind crabs (fried with garlic), half kg of tiger prawns(grilled) and a fish(steamed). So fresh, so good with staff weighing the seafood right in front of you and price stated upfront so everything is agreed upon before ordering or consuming. Loved the experience though it wasn't a beachfront eatery. Having been to other eateries all full of Russian tourists, Quan Bi Bo was a breath of fresh air and NOT a tourist trap unlike many other sea food/bo ke places. Highly recommended!

About Mui Ne - and BiBo
Apr 2019
This stretch of road in Mui Ne is ... putrid filth ridden.

Lots and I means LOTs of “massage” houses. Beautiful resorts aplenty, however Mui Ne is a tourist sex destination.

About BiBo : 

BiBo restaurant have been here for 10 years and and at a nearby similar location for 20 before that. Their reputation for quality fare and honesty is well known to locals.

There are fish tanks out the front and u pick what u want to eat. It’s all cooked and grilled to perfection.

They actually charge you as advertised. And the seafood you pick is actually what you picked not some dodgy under-counter switch for expired or other fish that they sell in place of what you have ordered. And if it’s a kilo your ordering your getting a kilo, not 850grams.

There are maybe 40 other places who look similar to BiBo on this stretch.

I asked my driver to recommend a place to eat ocean fresh seafood and so he dropped me off at a location where 3 dudes try to usher me out of the cab and drag me into their “seafood” place. Not safe.

No such hassle encountered at BiBo
